correctness.rationale: For fixed r>=2 and m>=2 with r(m-1)>m, contracting a designated m-subset in each independent uniform partition gives P(I_S)= (B_(n-m+1)/B_n)^r. The exact second factorial moment distinguishes disjoint sets S,T (contraction to n-2m+2) and overlapping sets |S∩T|=j>=1 (contraction to n-2m+j+1). Fixed-shift Bell ratios B_(n-d)/B_n~(W(n)/n)^d imply E(X_m)_2=o(E X_m) in the rare regime. Bonferroni yields the exact relative rare-block asymptotic, and E X_(m+1)=o(E X_m) plus uniqueness of m-witness shows exactly one m-class conditionally; exchangeability makes its location exactly uniform.
